title: Melromarc’s Darkness
paragraphs: “Where is this place?”
“Some town… maybe?”

We used the portal to move to a certain town. There are large mansions around us. These must be the residences of the town’s nobles. The land is slightly elevated and offers a good view. The security seems a bit tight, with walls at the entrances and exits of the town.

We used the portal to move near one of those noble mansions. Oh, right. Father has managed to get back all the clothes he was wearing right after the summoning in every loop so far, which had been taken by the pig. Apparently, he retrieved them before they were sold off.
How should I put it…? Including the chainmail, it feels like he’s finally gotten everything back. I think he had it all in the first world too.
“Now then, I’ll cast concealment magic and use the skill. Make sure you’re touching me.”
“Yeah.”
“Understood.”
“Okay. As long as we’re touching Motoyasu-kun, we’re fine, right?”
After confirming that everyone was touching me, I simultaneously used my concealment skill and magic to hide our presence.
“Alright, we’re sneaking in. Make sure to stay close.”
We jumped over the wall. With my current stats, something like this is a piece of cake.
“Wow, just like a ninja.”
“Father will be able to do it eventually too.”
“So, I can do that after leveling up? I’m looking forward to it.”
Well, I’ve never actually seen Father use any stealth-type skills or magic. Since he’s a shield hero, he tends to focus more on skills that draw attention.
“Shh!”
A guard, who looks like he’s on watch, is approaching. It seems there are also guard beasts around. This is a bit troublesome…
However, the magic and skill I cast have powerful corrections applied to them. There’s no way they’ll be able to spot us. Of course, the Queen and Fiancée are with us as well.
“Is this where they’re being held? If the top authority is here, wouldn’t it be better not to sneak in?”
Hearing Father’s words, the Queen shook her head.
“If we conduct an inspection from the front, they’re likely to make excuses. They’ll claim they’re providing protection. In the worst case, they might even get rid of them.”
“That’s true…”

What Father asked me to do was to rescue big Sister. I explained to the Queen Big Sister, who had been a great help as Father’s ally, was being abused as a noble’s slave in Melromarc. I also asked her to protect the slaves from the land that had been established through the friendship between Melromarc and Siltvelt. Since it hasn’t been too long yet, we should be able to save many more than last time. Father naturally wants to rescue big Sister who was supposed to be his future right hand. But since it’s a good opportunity, we also brought Ren and Itsuki along.

The Queen and Fiancée… are they in the position of the feudal lord and the emblem, like in Mito Komon? Well, the nobles of this country are likely to claim that the Queen is an imposter when things get inconvenient, like the scum they are. If they defy the Queen, I’m ready to obliterate them. This time, I have official permission. This is the punishment for making big Sister suffer in all the previous loops. Of course, it was confirmed in the previous loop Big Sister was being held captive in this mansion. I also made sure to memorize the layout.
“Once we’re this far, the security should be a bit lax. Let’s move.”

We crossed the courtyard and slowly opened the door to enter the building. Fortunately, the door wasn’t locked. The security is completely careless. They haven’t even considered the possibility of an aerial infiltration.

Have they not thought about dealing with dragon knights? Well, flying in so blatantly would get us caught immediately. After that, I opened the entrance to the basement as per the information I gathered beforehand through connections with slave traders and prior investigations. The priority is to ensure big Sister’s safety first. Gathering evidence comes next. The plan is for the Queen to witness the scene herself and then formally accuse the higher-ranking nobles. Father has already given me permission to eliminate them if they resist. Well, it’s something that’s prohibited by Melromarc’s laws anyway. They’ll pay for all the suffering they caused in the previous loops. I chanted a spell to prevent noise as we descended the basement stairs. Along the way, there was a locked door, but I sliced through it effortlessly with the tip of my spear.
“Ugh… something smells awful…” Ren groaned, holding his nose.
The stench of death is in the air. This is the kind of smell that’s been festering for years.
“Is she here?”
“Most likely.”
There’s no solid proof Big Sister is being held here. We’re only going off the timeline based on the information the monster merchant investigated.
“Hey!”

Suddenly, a loud crack echoed… The sound of a whip. The chances of being discovered are extremely low, but we crouched down and carefully moved toward the source of the sound. A dim torchlight illuminated the basement.
At the back, there was a cage, and hanging in front of it was… big Sister, perhaps? The distinctive ears and tail were visible. She looked a little haggard. And a chubby noble was whipping her.
“Ugh…”

A pained voice… but she seems too short to be big Sister. Ah, that’s right, demi-humans grow taller as they level up. So this must be how big Sister looked before meeting Father. It’s hard to judge, though, given how emaciated she is.
“Cry louder, damn it!”
“Ugh…!”
She was desperately holding back her voice, trying not to cry… That determination reminded me of a glimpse of big Sister I first met in the original world.
“Come on! I said cry, damn it!”
And yet, he’s doing this in broad daylight.
I expected him to be lazing around upstairs, but he’s abusing her during the day?
“You filthy demi-humans exist only to suffer and writhe in pain! Too many of you don’t understand that! You’re born evil and yet dare to live shamelessly in our country!”
Was he laughing or yelling? His voice was somewhere in between.
Or is he just angry? I can’t understand the nobles of this country.
“This world belongs to humans! How dare you, who are no better than monsters, act like people! Suffer! Your suffering is our salvation! Hahahaha!”
I grabbed Itsuki as he was about to jump out impulsively. At the same time, Ren and the Queen held him back as well.
“Don’t stop me! I can’t just stand by and let this happen!”
“I understand how you feel. But if she’s taken hostage while she’s weak… we’ll fail to rescue her.”
My restraint seemed to help Itsuki suppress his burning sense of justice. Father, on the other hand, had already flipped a switch—his expression was grim.
“It’s not even about justice… but no sane person would do something like that. I was weak too, and had to be saved, but… it seems like the entire country wanted to do that to me.”

Father was thinking carefully about how to save her. Even when he couldn’t do anything himself, he would always search for a way to help. He looked at the Queen. The Queen and Fiancée lowered their eyes apologetically.
“Melty, remember this well. This is the darkness of our nation. What Ault… what Trash is promoting is exactly this.”
“Yes, Mother… This is wrong.”
The Queen had always been troubled by the issue of demi-human discrimination. She must want Fiancée to witness this cruelty firsthand.
